name: XeedQ
description: XeedQ develops quantum processors based on spin qubits in diamond, producing compact, energy-efficient solid-state quantum computers. Awarded EUR 30 million by the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative, the company aims to deliver a 32-qubit fault-tolerant system by 2026 and 256+ qubit mobile processors by 2028.

products.name: Diamond Spin Qubit Processor
products.description: Compact, energy-efficient solid-state quantum computer based on spin qubits in diamond with fault-tolerant architecture

highlights: EUR 30M awarded by DLR Quantum Computing Initiative

sources.title: DLR awards 30 million Euros to XeedQ

news.title: The German Aerospace Center (DLR) awards 30 million Euros to XeedQ GmbH for building a unique quantum computer
news.excerpt: XeedQ GmbH wins a 30 million Euros contract from DLR for building a scalable quantum computer by 2026 at the DLR-Innovationszentrum in Ulm, GERMANY.
